content: bgfx.cmake README + root CMakeLists.txt confirm: primary usage is add_subdirectory(); bx/bimg/bgfx are nested git submodules under bgfx.cmake's own repo root (paths bx/, bimg/, bgfx/), overridable via BX_DIR/BIMG_DIR/BGFX_DIR cache vars. install(EXPORT) DOES exist (BGFX_INSTALL=ON by default) producing bgfxConfig.cmake/bgfxTargets.cmake exposing target bgfx::bgfx -- so ExternalProject_Add + find_package(bgfx CONFIG) is a fully viable, idiomatic path consistent with this repo's convention, contrary to initial assumption that add_subdirectory was required.
